路灯不亮、找食物援助、有人突然受伤，需要的是不同入口。先判断有没有即时人身危险，: A broken streetlight, looking for food assistance and a sudden injury each need a different door. First decide whether anyone is in immediate danger, then work out which city and county the problem is in; your home address doesn't always decide who is responsible. Describing the need clearly saves transfers and makes the follow-up easier to keep.
先选对求助类型: Choose the right kind of help
911：火灾、严重医疗急症或正在发生的人身危险，立即联系紧急服务，不等网页工单。: 911: contact emergency services immediately for fire, a serious medical emergency or immediate danger to a person. Do not wait for a web service request.
311：城市信息与设施问题，如坑洞、路灯、涂鸦和非法弃置；具体受理类别依城市与地: 311: city information and infrastructure issues such as potholes, streetlights, graffiti and illegal dumping. Accepted categories depend on the city and location.
211：找食物、住房、账单或家庭支持的非紧急资源转介。咨询免费，不表示被转介项目: 211: non-emergency referrals for food, housing, bills and family support. The consultation is free; the referred program may have fees, eligibility rules or limited capacity.
按城市报修，按县查援助: Report by city and find support by county
旧金山：使用 SF311；市内可拨 311，市外查官方完整号码，也可从 SF.g: San Francisco: use SF311. Call 311 within the city, check the official full number from outside it, or find services through SF.gov.
San José：用 San José 311 网站或应用选择当前问题类别，并保: San José: select the current issue category on the San José 311 website or app and save the receipt and tracking number.
Oakland：一般问题走 OAK311 网页；正在发生的积水、倒树等设施急事按: Oakland: use the OAK311 website for ordinary issues. Follow its telephone instructions for active infrastructure problems such as flooding or fallen trees; call 911 if someone faces immediate danger.
各县：从 211 Bay Area 或县运营方按城市、邮编找援助。电话、短信与在: Counties: search 211 Bay Area or the county provider by city or ZIP code. Telephone, text and online response hours may differ; state the language you need.
其他城市不要默认能拨 311；从市府官网找 Report a problem 或: Do not assume 311 works in every city. Find Report a problem or Public Works on the city website. If a three-digit number fails, use the official full number or website.
让报告可以定位，也方便追踪: Make the report easy to locate and follow up
报修写问题地址、最近路口、道路哪一侧、发现时间和实际影响。照片只拍安全位置能看见: A report should give the address, nearest intersection, side of the street, when you noticed it and what it affects. Photograph only public facilities or conditions visible from a safe spot, avoiding faces, car contents and private papers. Keep IDs, account and medical details out of public description fields, and put contact details only in the official fields. Save the case number and add updates to the original report instead of filing the same issue twice; when it says “transferred,” keep following up on the result.
问题位于［城市／地址或路口／道路一侧］。我在［日期时间］发现［具体问题］，目前影: The issue is at [city/address or intersection/side of street]. At [date and time], I observed [specific problem], affecting [walking/lighting/other]. The photo shows [public facility or issue]. Please confirm whether your department handles this; if a referral is needed, please provide the correct contact and follow-up method.
向 211 咨询时，先报所在县或邮编、最急的一项需求和语言；拿到转介后，再向实际: For 211, begin with your county or ZIP code, the most urgent need and your language. After a referral, confirm appointments, documents, costs and waiting times with the actual provider.
CalFresh 食物补助的金额: How much CalFresh food aid pays
加州社会服务部 2026 年 9 月的通知（官网，2026-10-17）写明：C: A September 2026 notice from the California Department of Social Services (official site, October 17, 2026) says CalFresh (California’s food aid) maximum monthly amounts for the year that began in October 2026 and runs to the end of September 2027, already in effect, are $306 for 1 person, $562 for 2, $808 for 3 and $1,023 for 4. These are ceilings; the actual amount is worked out from household income and deductions and decided by your county social services department.
